name: routines
about: Routines on the chat's own model (16 Nov 2026, chat/routines.rs; built 15 Nov in #131, until now only its e2e spec): a made-up meeting first; then a Skill of the person's own (a Skill runs on the meetings) on a schedule two minutes away, run by the scheduler with the person in another app — its own chat, named after the Skill and marked in Chat's list, its one quiet card on the Yap bar — following its instructions (on the plan they never reached Claude Code before: "There's no /… command", fixed in chat/turn/plan.rs `across_lines`); then Run now into the same chat; then a Skill on one meeting after another made-up meeting ends, with the meeting's note (a new Ask thread there). On the plan its calls are Claude Code's; on --fake the fake AI answers.

steps.note: A made-up meeting, recorded and ended (test mode's lines, fictional people): the revised budget by Friday, the launch on the third of March.

args.name: Latest points
args.instructions: From my latest meeting, list who agreed to do what and by when, in at most two short bullets.

steps.note: A schedule two minutes away (the scheduler looks every 30 s): the run is a turn of the lab's own.
Its time came, it ran in its own chat, on the meeting's words.
The Skill's instructions reached the model: no "There's no /latest-points command".
Its chat marked in Chat's list with the clock-arrow.
Settings' Run now, on the same routine.
A second run goes to the same chat.

args.name: Meeting points
args.instructions: From this meeting, list who agreed to do what and by when, in at most three short bullets.

steps.note: After any meeting, with the meeting's note.

args.lines: them: The packaging quote is final now.|you: Thanks. Sam, can you send it to finance by Wednesday?|them: Yes, I will send it to finance on Wednesday morning.

steps.note: Run on the meeting that ended once its summary was written (or couldn't be), into a new Ask thread on its note.
That meeting's words: the quote to finance by Wednesday.
